assumptions.statement: Official competition polygons, GIS regulatory controls, road redlines, comprehensive ownership, heritage, municipal utilities, fire safety, and engineering constraints are not available in the public site package. Public records now verify one Dazhongsi land transaction and one Qinghe construction contract, but these cover only their named parcels or project segment.
assumptions.impact: The verified records may constrain their exact subjects, but all corridor-wide land-use, building, transport and phasing geometry remains conceptual and must be reconciled before statutory or engineering use.

assumptions.statement: A three-route field protocol now specifies timestamps, location accuracy, direction, privacy-cleared photo hashes and reviewer sign-off, but no qualifying observation has yet been captured. Resident interviews, timed pedestrian counts, accessibility audits, thermal comfort surveys and sensor inventory remain incomplete.
assumptions.impact: The package contains a verifiable survey method and zero completed field observations; it does not claim achieved field performance or documented co-creation.

assumptions.statement: The repository's provisional Dazhongsi key-area polygon may be spatially offset from the named station and district.
assumptions.impact: No parcel, intersection, building, or station-integration decision is inferred from that polygon; the concept must be relocated and recalculated against official geometry.

assumptions.statement: Operators, maintenance entities, funding, audit bodies, and response-time commitments for proposed AI services are not yet appointed.
assumptions.impact: Projects remain reversible pilots and may not deploy until responsibility, stop conditions, non-AI equivalents, and complaint routes are assigned.
